metadata.descriptive_tail_note: p95 is a descriptive linear interpolation over n=5 samples; it is not a tail-latency estimate
metadata.formula_constraint_note: formula_ir_constraint_count includes semantic definitions; solver_goal_count and solver assumption counts identify actual solver-facing volume
metadata.measurement_note: fresh driver process per case per round; peak RSS is Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss
metadata.solver_time_note: solver_time_ms is the per-manifest sum of persisted obligation elapsed times, not one wall-clock solver phase

timing_stability.interpretation: advisory measurement-quality control only; it is not a semantic test result
